original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Resolve the current selected review, separate complex/ordinary BIT/admitted BIT/outer budgets, and compare the card against live handoffs before starting. Historical ceilings require exact source/model equivalence.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; not a scientific replay or all-size proof. Materialize selected inputs if this checkout is sparse.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Add explicit issue/PR reference queries and author/creation-date filters to the complete cached PR body search, with explicit unknown-metadata failure and legacy refresh.
scope_change_reason: A source-reuse collision was already represented in the complete body cache but was missed by a targeted indexed search and a broad task query. This is an original coordination-tooling improvement, not another predecessor verification or a scientific replay speedup.
bottleneck_link: Coordination side result: expose recent source reuse before spending work on a target. It changes no multiplication bound or supplier obligation.
stop_rule: Stop after one working source-specific query with passing regression coverage and explicit cache-coverage limits. Do not extend to semantic novelty detection.
evidence: Nine new behavioral regression groups and the 37 existing overlap groups pass. The actual source-reference/author/date query retrieves PR6571 from the fetched open-PR corpus. VALIDATION.json records a generated hash-bound local execution.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

open_questions.question: Can a separately scoped package-provenance index surface uncited reuse without treating missing references as novelty?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Reference matching cannot detect a shared model whose source is not cited.
open_questions.first_step: Compare exact package-path references in PR bodies with a complete changed-file inventory and report coverage explicitly.
open_questions.blocked_by: Missing citations, renames and semantic equivalence require separate evidence; no automatic novelty claim is justified.

claim_type: workflow tooling with behavioral regression evidence
originality: The CLI integration, author/creation metadata handling and regression fixtures are new. Existing numeric-reference matching, cache paging and source-history infrastructure retain their predecessor credit.
unrun_obligations: All mathematical predecessor replays and selected cold replay

overlap.coverage: Live handoffs, active Discussions, open/account PR lists, complete cached open-PR/Discussion pagination, main-tree distinctive and general-form searches, and merged author/filter searches.
overlap.limits: Arbitrary diffs, uncited semantic counterparts and unpublished work are not fully covered.

additional_local_check.command: Construct unittest.TestSuite from unittest discovery of each matching file and run with warning-strict isolated CPython 3.12.
